acceptance: With SITE_INPUTS pointing at a develop bundle whose package_version is not 0.5.0, the assembled landing page reads `Current release: `v0.5.0``, and a test asserts the version comes from the pin, not SITE_INPUTS
With DOCS_INPUTS set to a fixture directory, assembly, docs:check and docs:generate read that directory; a test covers the override
With `release-pin/` absent and DOCS_INPUTS unset, assembly fails with a message naming the path and `npm run docs:pin`
`npm run docs:check -- --docs-mode block` exits 0 against the pin

`npm run build`, `npm run check`, `npm test -w website`, `npm run test:docs-contracts`, `node --test scripts/render-blog-charts.test.mjs`, `npm run lint:docs`, `npm run lint:comments`, `npm run lint:guard` and `npm run inventory:core-links -w website -- --check` pass
`rg -n "siteInputsPath\(\"docs-data|inputs, \"docs-data|inputs, \"repo-files" website docs-contracts scripts` finds no docs input still read from SITE_INPUTS
The landing request lists every reverted passage as file, source commit and the failing check, or states that none was needed
context:
Decisions (owner, 2026-11-12): Explorer data stays continuous from the newest bundle; only docs wait for a release. Cutover reverts only what the checks flag against v0.5.0; the other docs commits since the release are listed in the pull request for owner review, not audited. Known flagged candidate: #137 (90-query TPC-DS-OBT count). Docs commits since v0.5.0 on main: a6edff5 2a101a6 9b699fe f638c7c 4349fac 22a3a25 37f4919 9090989 1bc7d17 7c708b0 92c910f 896f8e8 plus any newer. Guardrails: never edit files under release-pin/ by hand; never weaken a docs-contracts check to pass; a revert removes unreleased statements only and keeps unrelated fixes in the same commit.

Delivered in pull request #145, squash-merged to main as fdcc060 with ci green on fb3a119. Implemented on the shared integration branch feat/docs-release-pin; independent review found no Critical and its two Required findings were fixed before merge.
description:
Problem: docs assembly, docs:check, docs:generate and the blog chart renderer read docs inputs from the develop bundle in SITE_INPUTS. Outcome: they read `release-pin/` by default, so `main` publishes docs for the pinned release; the Explorer, result summaries, prompt catalog and deploy gates keep reading SITE_INPUTS.

Change: add one resolver for the docs inputs root: `DOCS_INPUTS` when set, else `release-pin/` in the repository. Route through it: `assembleAuthoredDocs`/`assembleDocsSource` (manifest package_version for `{{package_version}}`, docs-data, repo-files.json), `website/scripts/generate-docs-pages.ts`, `docs-contracts/cli.ts` default `--inputs`, `scripts/render-blog-charts.mjs` `benchboxVersion`, and the website tests that load docs-data. `docs/README.md` keeps the `{{package_version}}` token. Leave `bundleManifest()`, results-summary, snapshot-mount, prompt-catalog, deploy/ and explorer/ on SITE_INPUTS.

Cutover: with the v0.5.0 pin, run `npm run docs:check -- --docs-mode block`, the website build and `npm run inventory:core-links -w website -- --check`. For each failure caused by docs or blog content describing unreleased core, restore the page text from before the offending commit (docs touched since 2026-11-06) with the smallest edit, and record file, commit and reason in a list for the pull request; that content is restored on `next` later. For a failure caused by site code needing a contract field the v0.5.0 pin lacks, make the code tolerate its absence only where the field is already optional in types; otherwise stop and report.

Constraints: clean cutover, no fallback from pin to SITE_INPUTS when the pin is missing (fail with the path and `npm run docs:pin`). No explanatory comments. Do not change bundle verification, deploy receipts or the Explorer.
